user.title: Samsung washing machine
user.description: The appliance needs a client certificate signed by Samsung's AC14K_M CA and a device token. Both can be produced with the scripts in the tools folder of the repository; see the README.

data_description.host: Give the appliance a fixed address in your DHCP server, otherwise the integration will lose it.
data_description.token: The 10-character token the appliance sent back to the listener on port 8889.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the device token
reauth_confirm.description: The appliance at {host} rejected the current token. Request a new one and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: The appliance is not reachable. Switch it on at the panel, then switch Remote Control on (the door has to be closed) and try again: while idle it leaves the network again after a few minutes unless Remote Control is on. If it is on a smart plug, check that the plug is on.
error.control_disabled: The appliance answered, but refuses to serve while its Wi-Fi control function is switched off. Switch Remote Control (Smart Control) on at the panel, with the door closed, and try again. The certificate and the token are fine.
error.invalid_auth: The appliance rejected the device token.
error.invalid_certificate: The certificate or the private key could not be used. Check that both PEM blocks were pasted in full.

add_wash_last_rinse.name: 6b. Alarm when the final rinse starts

offline.message: The appliance at {host} is not reachable. While idle it stays on the network only with Remote Control switched on - and it is off the network entirely when it is switched off at the panel or unpowered.

control_disabled.message: The appliance at {host} refuses to be controlled while its Wi-Fi control function is switched off. Switch Remote Control (Smart Control) on at the panel, with the door closed.

write_failed.message: The appliance did not apply the change: {details}

cancel_failed.message: The appliance did not cancel the cycle: {details}. Not every generation has a remote cancel: a TP6X_WW6500 accepts the Ready write and stays paused, and rejects Stop outright, so the cycle has to be ended at the panel.

unknown_programme.message: There is no programme called {programme} on this appliance. Known programmes: {known}. A raw course code such as 63 also works.

option_not_allowed.message: The programme {programme} does not allow {field} = {value}. It allows: {allowed}.

not_ready.message: The appliance is {state}, so a new cycle cannot be started. End the current one first.

unknown_device.message: {device_id} is not a Samsung Washer Local device.

remote_control_off.message: Remote Control is switched off on the appliance at {host}, so it will not start a cycle for anyone but the panel. Switch Remote Control on (the door has to be closed) and try again.

nothing_selected.message: No programme is selected yet. Pick one in the Programme to start dropdown, or call the start_cycle action with a programme.

start_cycle.name: Start cycle
start_cycle.description: Select a wash programme and start it. The appliance only accepts a programme together with a start, which is why this is one action rather than a setting. Anything left empty uses the programme's own default.

programme.name: Programme
programme.description: The programme name as the Programme sensor shows it (for example drum_clean), or its raw code (63) on a model whose codes are not mapped.

temperature.name: Water temperature
temperature.description: Only values this programme allows; see the allowed_temperature attribute of the Programme sensor.

rinse.name: Rinse cycles
rinse.description: Only values this programme allows; see the allowed_rinse attribute of the Programme sensor.

spin.name: Spin speed
spin.description: Only values this programme allows; see the allowed_spin attribute of the Programme sensor.
